fullDescription: A loud neo-brutalist acid-yellow CTA section: a hard-bordered window-style panel with a thick offset shadow, a tilted bordered headline with an acid knockout phrase, chunky press-down buttons, a black scrolling marquee, and three tilted step cards.
prompt:
## Resumo
A loud neo-brutalist CTA section built as a full-bleed acid-yellow band: the call to action is a hard-bordered 'window' panel (a black title bar reading '// design.cta.block' with three little square 'window' chips) sitting on cream paper with a thick 14px offset black shadow. Inside, an acid eyebrow tag, a slightly tilted bordered headline box ('SHIP THE UI. / SKIP THE / blank page.' with the last phrase highlighted in acid), a short subhead, two chunky press-down buttons (a black primary 'Grab a prompt' and a paper 'See it run'), and an uppercase mono trust line. Below the panel: an avatar proof row, then a black scrolling marquee strip of surfaces, then a 'how it works' section of three tilted bordered step cards and a closing black mini-CTA bar. Framed by a sticky paper nav with a thick bottom border.

## Estilo Visual
Build a loud neo-brutalist 'acid' look. Three colors only: paper cream #f4f1ea (background), ink near-black #0a0a0a (borders, text, the dark band/buttons), and ONE electric accent acid #e8ff00 (the hero band, highlight on the headline phrase, eyebrow tags, button arrows, marquee asterisks, alternating avatar chips). Every surface is defined by THICK solid black borders (border-[3px] on small chips, border-4 on panels/cards/buttons) and PURE HARD OFFSET SHADOWS with zero blur: define utilities shadow-hard = 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a, shadow-hard-lg = 10px 10px 0 0 #0a0a0a, shadow-hard-xl = 14px 14px 0 0 #0a0a0a, and an acid double-shadow 8px 8px 0 0 #e8ff00, 8px 8px 0 2px #0a0a0a. Buttons use a .btn-press interaction: transition transform/box-shadow ~.08s; on hover translate(2px,2px) and shrink shadow to 4px 4px; on active translate(6px,6px) and shadow to 0 (it physically presses into its shadow). Tilt accents: .tilt-l = rotate(-1.6deg), .tilt-r = rotate(1.2deg). Headlines use .headline = line-height .92, letter-spacing -.02em, uppercase. Add a dotted texture utility .grid-dots = radial-gradient(#0a0a0a 1.4px, transparent 1.4px) at 22px 22px tile, used as faint (~18% opacity) strips along the band edges. Three Google fonts: Archivo (display, weights 500-900, use 900 'font-black' for headlines), Space Grotesk (body, 500-700), Space Mono (mono, 400/700, for eyebrow tags and trust lines). Antialiased. Keep it blunt: no gradients, no blur, no rounded corners (everything is hard rectangles).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) on solid paper #f4f1ea with a THICK bottom border (border-b-4 border-ink). Inside a max-w-6xl row, px-5->8 py-3.5, justified between: LEFT = a 36px square acid logo tile (border-[3px] border-ink bg-acid, shadow-hard) holding a ph:square-half-bold icon, beside an Archivo font-black 'PROMPTYARD' wordmark (~text-xl, tight tracking); CENTER (hidden on mobile, md:flex, gap-7) = four Archivo bold links 'Library / How it works / Packs / Pricing' (~15px) that fade to ink/60 on hover; RIGHT = an acid 'Start free' button (border-[3px] border-ink bg-acid, shadow-hard, btn-press) with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold that nudges right on hover.

### Acid full-bleed hero band
A full-width section (w-full) with bg-acid #e8ff00 and a thick black bottom border (border-b-4 border-ink). Pin two faint .grid-dots dotted strips (h-16, opacity .18, pointer-events-none) along the top and bottom inside edges of the band. Vertical padding py-20->28. It holds the CTA window panel and the avatar proof row, centered in a max-w-6xl column.

### Brutalist CTA window panel
A centered max-w-4xl panel: border-4 border-ink, bg-paper, shadow-hard-xl (14px offset black). It opens with a 'window' TITLE BAR: a black bar (bg-ink, border-b-4 border-ink) px-4->6 py-2, justified between, with a Space Mono uppercase ~11px tracked label '// design.cta.block' in paper on the left, and three little 12px square 'window' chips on the right (border-2 border-paper; the MIDDLE one filled bg-acid). The panel body is px-6->12 py-10->14, centered.

### Eyebrow tag
Inside the panel body, an inline acid tag, mb-7: border-[3px] border-ink bg-acid px-3 py-1, shadow-hard, holding a ph:lightning-fill icon + Space Mono uppercase ~11px tracked text '1,200+ ready-to-ship prompts'.

### Tilted bordered headline box
The hero of the panel: a .tilt-l (rotate -1.6deg) inline-block box, border-4 border-ink, bg-paper, shadow-hard-lg, px-4->8 py-3->5, mx-auto mb-8. Inside, an Archivo font-black (900) UPPERCASE h1 at text-[38px]->[58px]->[72px] with .headline (line-height .92, -.02em). It is three lines: 'Ship the UI.' / 'Skip the' / then the phrase 'blank page.' wrapped in an inline acid highlight (bg-acid px-2, slightly negative -mx-1) so only that phrase is knocked out in acid.

### Subhead
A centered max-w-xl Space Grotesk paragraph, mb-9, ~text-base->lg, font-600, leading-snug, color ink/80: 'Steal a battle-tested design prompt, drop it into your AI agent, get a real interface back in seconds. No fiddling, no fluff.'

### Chunky button row
A centered row that stacks on mobile and goes row on sm (gap-4). PRIMARY = a black button 'Grab a prompt': border-4 border-ink, bg-ink, text-paper, Archivo font-800 uppercase tracked text-lg, px-7 py-4, shadow-hard, .btn-press, with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold in ACID that translates right on hover. SECONDARY = a paper button 'See it run': border-4 border-ink, bg-paper, same type, shadow-hard, .btn-press, with a leading ph:play-circle-bold. Both go w-full on mobile, w-auto on sm.

### Trust line
Beneath the buttons, mt-7, a centered Space Mono uppercase ~12px tracked line in ink/55: 'Free to start · No card · Copy & paste ready'.

### Avatar proof row
Below the panel, mt-9, a centered flex-wrap row: an overlapping (-space-x-2.5) cluster of four 36px square avatar chips (border-[3px] border-ink, alternating bg-paper / bg-acid, Archivo font-900 initials 'JR' 'MK' 'DV' '+9'), beside an Archivo font-700 ~text-sm ink/80 line 'Loved by 9,400 builders shipping faster this week'.

### Marquee strip
A full-width black ticker: w-full overflow-hidden, border-b-4 border-ink, bg-ink, py-3. A flex w-max track with a CSS marquee animation (translateX 0 -> -50%, 22s linear infinite) duplicated twice for a seamless loop. Each copy is an Archivo font-800 uppercase tracked ~text-sm row in paper, of surfaces 'Dashboards / Landing pages / Pricing tables / Onboarding flows / Mobile apps', each preceded by a ph:asterisk-bold icon in ACID.

### How-it-works section + closing mini-CTA bar
A paper section (bg-paper) py-20->24 in the max-w-6xl column. A left-aligned header: an acid mono tag 'How it works' (border-[3px] border-ink bg-acid shadow-hard) then an Archivo font-black uppercase .headline h2 'Three blunt steps. / Zero blank page.'. Then a md:grid-cols-3 gap-7 of three step cards (border-4 border-ink, shadow-hard-lg; cards 1 & 3 .tilt-r + bg-paper, card 2 bg-acid): each card has a top row with a 48px square numbered chip (border-4 border-ink, alternating bg-acid/bg-paper, shadow-hard, Archivo font-900 numeral) and a ph step icon (magnifying-glass / clipboard-text / rocket-launch), then an Archivo font-800 uppercase h3 ('Pick a prompt' / 'Paste & run' / 'Ship the UI') and a Space Grotesk ink/75 body line. Close with a mt-14 dark mini-CTA bar: border-4 border-ink, bg-ink, shadow-hard-lg, px-7->10 py-7, stacking on mobile / row on sm, items-center justify-between: an Archivo font-900 uppercase paper headline 'Stop staring at the blank page.' and an acid 'Start free' button (border-4 border-paper, bg-acid, .btn-press) whose hard offset shadow is PAPER (box-shadow 6px 6px 0 0 #f4f1ea) so it pops against the black bar, with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Define a scale of pure brutalist drop shadows with ZERO blur and zero spread offset, just a solid black duplicate behind each surface: shadow-hard = 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a, shadow-hard-lg = 10px 10px 0 0 #0a0a0a, shadow-hard-xl = 14px 14px 0 0 #0a0a0a. There is also an 'acid' double shadow (8px 8px 0 0 #e8ff00, 8px 8px 0 2px #0a0a0a) for an extra-loud variant, and one inverted PAPER shadow (6px 6px 0 0 #f4f1ea) used only on the acid button inside the black mini-CTA bar.

### Componente
Every button physically presses into its own shadow. transition: transform .08s ease, box-shadow .08s ease. On :hover translate(2px,2px) and shrink the shadow to 4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a. On :active translate(6px,6px) and collapse the shadow to 0 0 0 0 (the button has fully 'pressed down'). Pair with an arrow icon that translate-x's on group-hover.

### Componente
Frame the CTA as a code/app 'window': the panel's top is a solid black bar (bg-ink, border-b-4 border-ink) carrying a Space Mono uppercase comment-style label '// design.cta.block' on the left and three tiny 12px square 'window control' chips on the right (border-2 border-paper, the middle one filled bg-acid). It sells the 'this is a real interface' brutalist coding metaphor.

### Componente
Within the all-ink uppercase headline, wrap ONLY the final phrase ('blank page.') in an inline acid highlight: an inline-block with bg-acid, px-2, a slight -mx-1 bleed and leading-[1.05], so it reads as a marker-pen knockout. It is the single loudest color moment and should be the only highlighted phrase.

### Componente
A pure-CSS infinite ticker: a w-max flex track holding the SAME list of surfaces twice (the second copy aria-hidden), animated marquee 22s linear infinite translating translateX(0) to translateX(-50%) so the duplicate seamlessly takes over. Runs in a black full-bleed strip; asterisk separators are acid.

### Componente
A faint dot texture only along the top and bottom inner edges of the acid band: radial-gradient(#0a0a0a 1.4px, transparent 1.4px) on a 22px 22px tile, placed as absolute pointer-events-none strips (h-16) at ~18% opacity, to add grit without overpowering the flat acid fill.

### Componente
Subtle rotation for energy: .tilt-l = rotate(-1.6deg) on the headline box; .tilt-r = rotate(1.2deg) on step cards 1 and 3. Keep tilts tiny (1-2deg) so the layout still reads as a grid, just hand-placed.

## Notas Especiais
Three colors ONLY: paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a, acid #e8ff00 — acid is rationed to the band, the one headline highlight phrase, eyebrow tags, arrows, marquee asterisks and alternating chips. Fonts via Google Fonts: Archivo (display, font-black 900 for headlines), Space Grotesk (body), Space Mono (mono eyebrow tags + trust lines). Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:square-half-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:lightning-fill, ph:play-circle-bold, ph:asterisk-bold, ph:magnifying-glass-bold, ph:clipboard-text-bold, ph:rocket-launch-bold). The whole language is THICK black borders + PURE hard offset shadows (no blur, no gradients, no rounded corners) + uppercase heavy type + the press-down button + the window-panel metaphor + a couple of 1-2deg tilts. To transfer the STYLE, keep that brutalist vocabulary and the rationing of the single acid accent; to transfer the LAYOUT, keep the framed page (sticky nav -> acid band with the windowed CTA panel + proof row -> black marquee -> how-it-works + dark closing bar). All copy uses no em-dashes.

Type does the shouting: a black-weight grotesque display, a tighter grotesque for body, and a monospace for the eyebrow tags and trust lines.
